messages:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered alert (ID: PD-8901) for service=redwood-inference/queue-ingest-usw2 - condition=queue_depth>100000 for 4m - severity=critical - runbook=https://internal/runbooks/queue-backlog

pagerduty: PD note: page fired to rotation 'eng-oncall' (policy: immediate + escalate 3m)

sarah: acked via PD. i'm taking lead, assigning investigation. @raj you're secondary if i need infra help.

raj: on it. can you paste head of queue metrics? i want to see which prefix/route is spiking.

sarah: grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/d/queues?panel=ingest_usw2 - snippet: top prefixes: 'kb-' 62k, 'user-' 21k, 'chat-' 18k. total backlog 101,324. avg dequeue rate 2.3k/s, ingest 4.8k/s

maria: looks like autoscaler didn't add nodes. i see scaler controller logs showing repeated "scale inhibited: quota_exceeded" around 1791123520.

raj: copying controller logs: ```2026-06-10T18:25:11Z scaleplan.go:92 INFO plan: desired=12 current=6 reason=queue_backlog
2026-06-10T18:25:12Z cloudapi.go:211 ERROR request failed: quotaExceeded: Insufficient project quota for VM creation
2026-06-10T18:25:13Z scaleplan.go:120 WARN scale aborted: quota_exceeded
```

sarah: thx. confirm: autoscaler wanted to double nodes but cloud quota prevented it. so customers are impacted. paging PD for higher severity?

pagerduty: PD update: escalation step 1: notified backup rotation. Next escalation in 3m if no ack from backup.

derek: @sarah @raj i'm on-call for capacity (infra). i see a quota spike from a batch job earlier, looks like quota was consumed by a windows infra job. i can request soft quota increase but that takes ~10-15min. we have short-term mitigations.

sarah: what are mitigations? can we drain non-critical fleets or evict low-priority workloads?

derek: yes — two options: 1) manually kill a couple ephemeral test fleets (low risk) to free quota; 2) reduce autoscaler desired for non-prod pools via `kubectl patch` to free nodes; 3) flip queue routing to a smaller model variant to reduce GPU footprint per request.

raj: option 3 could be fastest: reroute non-SLA traffic to smaller model variant 'gpt-medium-q4' and keep 'gpt-large-q8' for premium customers. routing is controlled by feature flag `route_fallback_small_model`. I can flip it in <2m.

sarah: do it. tag customers affected? we need to know if SLA tiers are blocked.

raj: flipping flag now -> `curl -XPOST https://config-api/flags/route_fallback_small_model -d '{"value":true,"scope":"usw2"}'`

incidents-bot: Config change applied by raj at 1791123589: route_fallback_small_model = true (scope: usw2)

raj: routing change propagated to edge within ~45s. visible in router logs: `2026-06-10T18:26:35Z router.go INFO route fallback applied for prefix kb-`

maria: dequeue rate jumped to 3.9k/s after the routing change, backlog down to 62k. good improvement but still high.

derek: i'm also going to evict a pair of test nodepools to free 4 vCPUs / 1 GPU each; that'll be about 6 minutes to drain + reprovision. proceeding now.

sarah: please annotate customer-facing status. OpsStatus: Partial degradation for non-enterprise customers in us-west-2.

maria: adding a short-term throttle for incoming burst spikes: adjusted ingress smoothing from 200ms window to 500ms to even out bursts. applied at 1791123602.

raj: we should also throttle long-running streaming sessions. adding limit: `max_tokens_per_minute=12000` for free tier. deploying policy patch.

incidents-bot: PD note: PD-8901 acknowledged by sarah at 1791123590. escalation suppressed.

sarah: thanks team. i'm updating the incident log and will prepare a short customer note. key points: autoscaler blocked by cloud quota, manual routing + node evictions + ingress smoothing reduced load, backlog reduced ~40% in 5m. still monitoring.

derek: cloud quota request opened (case# CQ-44321). support ETA ~12-18 min. if quota not increased, we'll need to hop to cross-region fallback (us-east-1) which adds latency. do we want to enable cross-region routing?

maria: cross-region would add ~70-120ms p95 on top of current latency. acceptable for some customers but not premium. we can gate by customer tier.

sarah: agree to enable cross-region for non-enterprise traffic if backlog doesn't drop below 10k in next 10m. set a watch timer.

raj: setting watch: if backlog > 10000 at 1791124200 do cross-region flip.

incidents-bot: Reminder set by sarah for 10m (check backlog threshold).

sarah: handoff: i'm 10m from end of shift; if this is still active at 1791124200, please escalate to oncall next (derek will own infra, raj will own routing). @maria please handle customer comms if needed.

derek: acknowledged. i'll keep monitoring quota case and node evictions.

maria: i'll draft the status update: "We are experiencing queue congestion in us-west-2 due to cloud quota limits preventing autoscaler from adding capacity. We have applied routing fallbacks and ingress smoothing to reduce impact; backlog is improving. Engineering is investigating and coordinating with cloud provider for quota increase."

sarah: thanks. I'll update the incident channel and PD notes. leaving thread to oncall rotation.

pagerduty: PD update: incident PD-8901 status=acknowledged assigned_to=sarah - next escalation window suspended.

incidents-bot: Thread closed by sarah at 1791123660 for handoff (state: monitoring).
